content:
Good news this morning for Apple Card Savings account users. Apple and Goldman Sachs are raising the account's interest rate from 3.4% to 3.5% starting today.

Apple and Goldman Sachs periodically adjust the Apple Card Savings account's annual percentage yield based on broader financial conditions.

This rate matches what Goldman Sachs offers on its Marcus savings account, though you can earn a limited-time 4.50% rate via this link.

The Apple Card Savings account is only available to Apple Card holders. After earning Daily Cash rewards through your Apple Card, you can transfer them to a Savings account or deposit funds directly into it.

Beyond transferring Daily Cash directly, Apple Card holders can also deposit funds via a linked bank account or Apple Cash balance. Interest compounds daily, meaning you earn returns not only on your principal but also on previously accumulated interest. When the monthly statement settles, accumulated interest is deposited directly into your savings account.

To learn more detailed information about the Apple Card Savings account, check out our complete guide.
